hint.zh: 接入聊天软件收发消息。
hint.en: Sends and receives messages on a chat platform.

when.zh: 接入任意即时通讯平台收发消息（QQ、Discord、Telegram、微信等），或依附于这类 World 的功能包。
when.en: Connects to any instant-messaging platform (QQ, Discord, Telegram, WeChat, etc.), or extends such a World.

hint.zh: 接入 QQ，或是某个 QQ World 的功能包。
hint.en: Connects to QQ, or is an add-on for a QQ World.

when.zh: 接入 QQ 或依附于某个 QQ World。QQ 生态有大量依附于宿主的功能包，所以单独设一个平台标签；同时也贴 im。
when.en: Connects to QQ or extends a QQ World. QQ has many add-on packs tied to a host, so it gets its own platform tag; also tag im.

hint.zh: 读直播间弹幕礼物，或为直播做演出。
hint.en: Reads a live room or performs for a stream.

when.zh: 读直播间的弹幕、礼物、观众信号，或为直播做演出（Live2D、字幕、OBS overlay）。只是在直播里玩过的游戏不算。
when.en: Reads a live room's chat, gifts or audience signals, or performs for a stream (Live2D, subtitles, OBS overlay). A game that was merely played on stream does not count.

hint.zh: 让 bot 玩或旁观一个游戏。
hint.en: Lets the bot play or watch a game.

when.zh: 让 bot 玩、操控或旁观一个游戏，包括桌游规则与跑团检定。
when.en: Lets the bot play, control or watch a game, including tabletop rules and TRPG checks.

hint.zh: 搜索、读网页或看视频获取信息。
hint.en: Searches, reads pages or watches videos for information.

when.zh: 搜索、读网页正文、看视频或字幕，用来获取外部信息。
when.en: Searches, reads web pages, or watches videos and subtitles to bring in outside information.

hint.zh: 让 bot 听、说或通话。
hint.en: Lets the bot listen, speak or take calls.

when.zh: 让 bot 听（语音识别）、说（语音合成）或通话。
when.en: Lets the bot listen (speech recognition), speak (speech synthesis) or take calls.

hint.zh: 桌宠、读前台窗口、判断在不在电脑前、操控鼠标键盘。
hint.en: Desktop pets, reading the foreground window, presence detection, mouse and keyboard control.

when.zh: 在用户的电脑桌面上出现或起作用：桌宠、读前台窗口、在不在电脑前、操控鼠标键盘。
when.en: Lives on or acts on the user's desktop: desktop pets, reading the foreground window, presence detection, mouse and keyboard control.

hint.zh: 帮 bot 记住、检索或整理过去的事。
hint.en: Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past.

when.zh: 帮 bot 记住、检索或整理过去的事：记忆库、聊天记录检索、笔记、相册、记忆体检。
when.en: Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past: memory stores, chat history search, notes, albums, memory health checks.

hint.zh: 情绪、好感、作息、时间感、节日、主动开口这类功能。
hint.en: Mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first.

when.zh: 让 bot 更像一个有自己生活的伙伴：情绪、好感、作息、时间感、节日、主动开口。
when.en: Makes the bot feel like a companion with a life of its own: mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first.

hint.zh: 让 bot 画画、生成图片这类作品。
hint.en: Lets the bot make works such as drawings and images.

when.zh: 让 bot 产出作品：画画、生成或修改图片、合成音频作品。
when.en: Lets the bot make things: drawing, generating or editing images, producing audio pieces.

hint.zh: 提醒、群管理、省 token 这类辅助功能。
hint.en: Helpers such as reminders, moderation and token savings.

when.zh: 提醒、群管理、限速防刷、省 token、给其他语言写插件的桥接这类运维与效率功能。上面的标签都不合适时才用。
when.en: Operational and productivity helpers: reminders, group moderation, rate limits, token savings, bridges for plugins in other languages. Use it only when none of the tags above fits.

hint.zh: 在本机跑模型，需要本机算力或显存。
hint.en: Runs a model on this machine; needs local compute or VRAM.

when.zh: 在用户本机跑模型推理（LLM、语音识别、语音合成），需要本机算力或显存。
when.en: Runs model inference on the user's machine (LLM, speech recognition, speech synthesis) and needs local compute or VRAM.

hint.zh: 装上包还不能用，要先另装游戏、mod 加载器、NapCat 等。
hint.en: Needs something else installed first, such as the game, a mod loader or NapCat.

when.zh: 装上包还不能用，得先另装别的东西：游戏本体或 mod 加载器（BepInEx）、NapCat、VTube Studio、Python 环境、模型权重、游戏服务器。
when.en: Installing the package is not enough; something else must be set up first: the game itself or a mod loader (BepInEx), NapCat, VTube Studio, a Python environment, model weights, a game server.

hint.zh: 模型能借它执行任意代码或命令、读写任意文件，或操控鼠标键盘。
hint.en: The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write any file, or control the mouse and keyboard.

when.zh: 官方审查后添加。模型能借它执行任意代码或命令、读写任意文件，或任意操控鼠标键盘。
when.en: Added after official review. The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write arbitrary files, or freely control the mouse and keyboard.

hint.zh: 会持续读取屏幕、麦克风、窗口等个人数据，并发给你配置的模型端点。
hint.en: Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone or windows, and sends it to your configured model endpoint.

when.zh: 官方审查后添加。会持续读取屏幕、麦克风、前台窗口或消费记录这类个人数据，并随模型调用发给模型端点。
when.en: Added after official review. Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone, foreground window or spending records, and sends it to the model endpoint with model calls.

hint.zh: 借用登录态或未公开接口调用服务，可能违反服务条款，账号有被限制的风险。
hint.en: Uses a login session or undocumented endpoint; may break the service's terms and put the account at risk.

when.zh: 官方审查后添加。借用网页登录态、CLI 额度或未公开接口调用服务，可能违反该服务的条款，账号有被限制的风险。
when.en: Added after official review. Calls a service through a web login session, a CLI quota or an undocumented endpoint; this may break the service's terms and put the account at risk.

hint.zh: 这个 World 在 bot 的 Memory 之外自己管理 bot 的内部状态（情绪、好感、记忆等），装上或卸下前后 bot 对自己的认知可能不一致。这类功能推荐在 bot 扩展的 Persona 里实现。
hint.en: This World manages the bot's internal state (mood, affinity, memories) outside the bot's Memory, so the bot's sense of itself may differ before and after it is installed or removed. We recommend building this into a bot extension's Persona instead.

when.zh: 官方审查后添加。World 自己保存并注入 bot 的情绪、好感、记忆、经历这类内部状态。
when.en: Added after official review. The World keeps and injects the bot's own internal state: mood, affinity, memories, experiences.

note.en: Reads the desktop and spending records

note.zh: 读取前台窗口并定期截取游戏画面
note.en: Reads the foreground window and periodically captures the game screen
Reads the desktop and spending records

note.zh: 借用 Gemini 网页登录态
note.en: Uses a Gemini web login session

note.zh: 运行任意 Python 插件代码
读取前台窗口、键鼠空闲并能截屏
note.en: Reads the foreground window and input idle time, and can take screenshots

note.zh: 借用 Gemini 网页登录态
note.en: Uses a Gemini web login session
